services.name: Pine straw installation
services.blurb: Old straw raked out, beds edged and weeded, new straw spread and tucked at the edge.

services.name: Long-leaf pine straw
services.blurb: Long needles that knit together and stay on a slope through a hard Gulf rain.

services.name: Bed edging
services.blurb: A spade-cut line between lawn and bed so the straw has something to lock against.

services.name: Bed cleanup and weeding
services.blurb: Weeds pulled by the root and old gray straw hauled off before anything new goes down.

services.name: Washout re-tuck
services.blurb: Straw that slid off a slope after a storm raked back up and tucked deeper.

services.name: Seasonal refresh
services.blurb: A top layer over last season's straw when the beds have gone gray but still hold.

services.name: Mulch installation
services.blurb: Hardwood mulch for beds by the pool, the door or anywhere you want darker color.

services.name: Shrub trimming
services.blurb: Azaleas, boxwoods and hollies shaped before the straw goes under them, clippings hauled off.

services.name: Leaf removal
services.blurb: Oak leaves blown out of the beds and off the lawn so new straw is not buried.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: We get water off the whole roof running down one side of the yard. Every spring the straw ended up at the curb. They cut a deep edge, tucked the low side and it was still there after that big May storm.
reviews.name: Earline D.

reviews.text: They raked out three years of old flat straw before putting anything down. I did not know there was that much under there. The beds look twice as deep now.
reviews.name: Boyd W.

reviews.text: Booked a fall refresh for Thanksgiving. Quick and neat, the driveway was blown off, nothing stuck in the boxwoods, and the straw was a good deep red.
reviews.name: Nan G.

reviews.text: The edge is what sold me. My yard man used to just dump straw on top of the grass line. Royce's crew cut a clean curve around the oak and the straw sits inside it like it was poured in.
reviews.name: Cecil R.

reviews.text: Got my azaleas trimmed and the beds weeded in the same visit. They told me which weeds were coming back from runners and pulled those out by the root instead of covering them.
reviews.name: Marla J.

reviews.text: Texted a photo of my beds on Monday, had a bale count back that afternoon and the crew was here Thursday morning at seven like they said.
reviews.name: Dewayne P.

proof.guarantee: If rain moves straw off a slope we tucked within 30 days, we come back and re-tuck it at no charge.

prices.note: depends on how long it has gone
